# Tab single

Figma: `Tab single`, node `347:15180` (page Components, `1:28`).
6 variants - `state[2]` x `style[3]`.

**One tab, not the tab group.** The group is a separate standalone component
(`Tab group`) and is not yet built.

`style` adds a leading glyph or image. It does not change the box, so it is a slot rather
than a modifier.

## Markup

State lives on `aria-selected`, so the accessible state and the visual state cannot drift
apart:

```html
<div role="tablist" aria-label="Sections">
  <button type="button" role="tab" class="v27-tab" aria-selected="true" id="t1" aria-controls="p1">
    Overview
  </button>
  <button type="button" role="tab" class="v27-tab" aria-selected="false" id="t2" aria-controls="p2">
    <svg class="v27-tab__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><!-- glyph --></svg>
    Details
  </button>
</div>
```

Each tab needs `aria-controls` pointing at its panel, and the panel needs
`role="tabpanel"` with `aria-labelledby` pointing back. A tablist without those is a row
of buttons, not a tab set.

## Classes

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-tab` | the tab; `aria-selected` drives the selected look |
| `.v27-tab__icon` | 20px leading glyph (`style=Icon`) |
| `.v27-tab__image` | 24px leading picture (`style=Image`) |

## Values

Verified on `347:15178` (Default) and `347:15179` (Selected).

| Property | Default | Selected |
|---|---|---|
| padding | 8px top and bottom, none either side | same |
| colour | `Foreground/Secondary` | `Foreground/Theme` |
| underline | none | 1px `Border/Theme` |
| type | Base - Outfit 16 / 400 / 20 | Outfit **500** / 16 / 20 |

The box is identical in both states; only the underline, the colour and the weight change.

Two implementation notes:

- The transparent bottom border sits on the base rather than being added on selection, so
  the tab does not shift by a pixel when selected. Figma draws no border on the unselected
  variant, which renders the same.
- The selected weight is **Outfit Medium (500)**, which belongs to no named text style in
  the file - every style is 400 or 600. It is a literal with its node id rather than a new
  token. FINDINGS.md #26.

## All classes in this component

`.v27-tab`, `.v27-tab__icon`, `.v27-tab__image`
